sys_script_client.description:
On incident form, when a VIP user is selected as caller in the ticket then an information message is displayed under the "Caller" field saying "This user is VIP."
Remove the message if caller is changed to empty or not VIP user.
Additional information: a VIP user is a user for whom the "VIP" field is set to "True".
sys_script_client.name: Warn VIP on field
